messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need a concrete shape for the audit ledger export for routing-policy changes. Requirements from product/compliance: who changed what, previous vs new values, policy_version, tenant, timestamp, and an optional justification. Also need redaction modes and retention knobs for exports/archives.

kevin: +1. Do we want NDJSON (one event per line) as the canonical export? That makes SIEM ingestion easy. Thinking fields: event_id, ts, actor_id, actor_type, tenant_id, change_type (create/update/delete), target (route_id), policy_version, rollup_id, field_deltas (array of {field, before, after}), reason, source (console/api), region, severity.

lia: NDJSON is fine. Important: we need explicit PII handling documented in the export. Propose three redaction modes: "full_redact" (remove actor + replace with pseudonym token), "hash" (sha256 of actor id), "none" (raw). Also require export metadata that lists which mode was applied and the applied KMS key id. Retention must be configurable per-tenant and have a minimum enforceable policy for enterprise customers.

kevin: Agree on redaction enum. For field_deltas we should keep it compact for size — only include diffs not entire object snapshots. Example NDJSON line: 
```
{"event_id":"evt_20240301_0001","ts":"2024-03-01T14:12:03Z","actor_id":"usr_789","actor_display":"j.choi","tenant_id":"t_acme","change_type":"update","target":"route_42","policy_version":"v3","rollout_id":"rl_55","field_deltas":[{"field":"match.priority","before":"10","after":"20"}],"reason":"traffic test","source":"console","redaction":"hash"}
```
(we can include actor_display only when redaction==none or pseudo, otherwise omit)

sanjay: Two operational asks: 1) export sizing/cost — we should support sampling for noisy tenants (e.g., 1% of admin changes) and a daily cap; 2) delivery modes — push to S3 (preferred), Kinesis, or webhook. Console should expose a scheduled export + on-demand download. Also need export job telemetry (bytes, events, duration) for billing/alerts.

maya: For sampling, product prefers deterministic sampling (hash(tenant+day) <= threshold) so it's reproducible. For SIEM customers, we should allow "full" export opt-in per tenant. Delivery: S3 with short-lived signed URLs + destination ACLs. On-demand downloads must honor redaction and tenant retention.

lia: Also add an "export_schema_version" top-level field so we can evolve shape without breaking consumers. And a field "pii_handling" with the enum we discussed. For compliance proofs, include "signed_by" and "signature" for export bundles if customer requests (KMS-backed).

kevin: Telemetry: tag each exported event with a route_hash (not the raw route id) to enable search without exposing route names. Also include "applied_in_canary": true/false for changes that are canary-only. For the API surface, propose endpoint POST /audit-exports with body {tenant_id, start_ts, end_ts, redaction_mode, delivery:{type,s3_bucket,role_arn}} and GET /audit-exports/{id}/status. We'll write an openapi snippet in the PR.

ops-bot: export-job-3344556689 started for tenant t_acme (mode=hash, delivery=s3) :rocket:

maya: Action items: kevin — draft openapi + NDJSON example and PR; lia — write compliance doc for redaction options/retention SLA text; sanjay — run a quick cost estimate for full export vs sampled; i'll wire console flags for scheduling + sampling slider. Aim to prototype in next sprint.

kevin: Sounds good. I'll include sample rollback/rollout_id mapping and add unit tests that validate we never emit raw actor ids when redaction!=none.

lia: Please add a test matrix for export_schema_version compatibility when we add field_deltas v2 (array vs compact patch).

maya: Thanks all. If anyone wants to join the sync tomorrow 10am, ping me.
